depiction.primary_object: round clock face with two angled bars on top

readings.meaning: scheduled time alert or loud reminder

ambiguity: Can be confused with the stopwatch when the two top bells are misread as timer push buttons, or with the plain clock if the bells are ignored.

reasoning: Shows an alarm clock with a circular dial, clock hands, and two top bells/bars. Best suited for tasks where an alarm clock, wake-up alarm, timepiece, or timer is the central subject, rather than just any task that happens at a specific time. Easily distinguished from a plain wall clock by the two angled bars on top.

pass1.ambiguity: Could be confused with a kitchen timer or stopwatch due to the top bars resembling push buttons rather than rounded bells.

distinguishing: Unlike the single-handed stopwatch with a center crown button or the bare wall clock, this clock face has two symmetrical angled bell bars on top and two clock hands, representing an alarm clock.
